summary: Xtra-Gold Resources Corp. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 6, 2026, reporting its unaudited interim consolidated financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026, along with management's discussion and analysis and CEO/CFO certifications. The filing is a routine periodic report by a foreign private issuer, containing no mention of any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change.
